description: This file contains unit tests for the GenreStatistics class in the book project, focusing on genre-related statistical methods such as most read, most liked, and least liked genres. It uses JUnit 5 and Spring annotations for integration testing.

classes.name: GenreStatisticsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing GenreStatistics, includes setup, cleanup, and multiple test cases for genre statistics functionality.

methods.name: GenreStatisticsTest
methods.description: Constructor with dependency injection for BookService and PredefinedShelfService.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment before each test, resets books, populates test data, and creates GenreStatistics instance.

methods.name: resetBookService
methods.description: Deletes all books from the book service to reset test data.

methods.name: findMostReadGenre
methods.description: Tests that the most read genre is correctly identified.

methods.name: findMostLikedGenre
methods.description: Tests that the most liked genre is correctly identified.

methods.name: findLeastLikedGenre
methods.description: Tests that the least liked genre is correctly identified.

methods.name: notShowMostLikedGenreWhenOnlyOneReadGenreExists
methods.description: Disabled test that checks behavior when only one genre exists; expected to be skipped or rewritten.

methods.name: saveBook
methods.description: Utility method to add a read book for testing purposes.

methods.name: notShowLeastLikedGenreWhenOnlyOneReadGenreExists
methods.description: Disabled test to verify behavior when only one read genre exists; users might need to rewrite this test.
